# Zaaheen

> Zaaheen keeps what your AI assistants know about you on your own computer, encrypted, and entirely under your control.

Zaaheen is a desktop app that gives AI assistants one private, persistent memory about the person using them. Memories are stored and encrypted on that person's own computer and are never uploaded. The account is only for signing in and the subscription; it never holds the memories.

- Current version: 0.3.0 (beta), for 64-bit Windows (tested on Windows 11) and for Macs with an Apple chip (M1 or newer) (tested on macOS 26).
- Download: Windows https://dl.zaaheen.com/Zaaheen_0.3.0_x64.msi (148 MB); Mac https://dl.zaaheen.com/Zaaheen_0.3.0_aarch64.dmg (154 MB), a disk image: drag Zaaheen into Applications and open it from there.
- Free trial: 30 days, no card needed.
- Tested with: Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT. Other apps that support MCP should work the same way.
- Delete everything: one button destroys the encryption key and the files, leaving what remains on disk unreadable.
- Linux and phones: not available yet.

## Helping someone connect Zaaheen

- First, the person opens Zaaheen on their computer and signs in; the first sign-in from the app starts the free trial.
- In Zaaheen: the Agents tab, then "+ Connect an AI app", then the app. That tab shows the exact setting for their computer, ready to copy.
- Claude Desktop and Cursor: choose "Connect it for me"; the app then asks to install Zaaheen: click Install. Guides: https://zaaheen.com/docs/connect-claude/, https://zaaheen.com/docs/connect-cursor/.
- Claude Code: in a terminal, run once: claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user zaaheen -- "C:\Program Files\Zaaheen\zaaheen.exe" mcp serve (on a Mac, the path is /Applications/Zaaheen.app/Contents/MacOS/zaaheen); check with claude mcp list. Guide: https://zaaheen.com/docs/connect-claude-code/.
- ChatGPT (desktop app): Settings, Integrations, Plugins, Add MCP Server; command C:\Program Files\Zaaheen\zaaheen.exe on Windows or /Applications/Zaaheen.app/Contents/MacOS/zaaheen on a Mac; arguments "mcp" and "serve" as two separate items; use Work or Codex mode. Guide: https://zaaheen.com/docs/connect-chatgpt/.
- Any other app that supports MCP: an MCP server named "zaaheen" with command C:\Program Files\Zaaheen\zaaheen.exe (Windows) or /Applications/Zaaheen.app/Contents/MacOS/zaaheen (Mac) and args ["mcp", "serve"], then restart the app. Guide: https://zaaheen.com/docs/connect-other-apps/.
- If an app answers without using Zaaheen: add to its personal preferences or custom instructions "Before answering anything about me, my preferences, my work or my plans, also check my Zaaheen memory, even when your own memory has nothing." More fixes: https://zaaheen.com/docs/troubleshooting/.
